correctness.rationale: Exact simplex cap volume, polytope facet support formula, and reflected Minkowski polynomial give the rational ratio. Differentiation after fixing a pair sum and product yields a strictly negative derivative; the numerator has strictly positive endpoint minima. The classical two-coordinate balancing characterization of majorization yields all-variable strictness and rigid sharp equality. The actual extracted standalone script checks 112 exact-rational convex hull cases, 6060 rational supporting facet triangles, and 75 derivative identities; tests corroborate, while the full proof is analytic. No unsupported inference from finite samples.

value.rationale: The equality family of Rogers--Shephard/Godbersen inequality is a simplex, and independently clipping its three vertices is a natural analytic perturbation with three affine-invariant parameters. The strict majorization law gives the complete sharp response to distributing fixed total barycentric cut depth; it distinguishes true three-cut geometry from the already-known single-cut endpoint, with explicit rigid extrema. This is a motivated exact geometric classification, not merely a re-labeled identity or routine global-inequality corollary.
